title: Selecting the Share a Plan Letter Covers on a Waiting Crossover Line
content:
The share taken when a waiting crossover line under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies is settled is selected from the benefit the waiting line falls under.

1. **Where a line waiting on the supplement falls under foreign travel emergency care** — the plan letter's foreign travel coinsurance is taken.
2. **Where a line waiting on the supplement falls under skilled nursing facility care** — the plan letter's share of the skilled nursing coinsurance is taken.
3. **Where neither of those holds** — the plan letter's share of the Part B coinsurance is taken.

The cases are taken in that order: a waiting line falling under foreign travel emergency care selects the foreign travel coinsurance even where a line falling under skilled nursing facility care also stands waiting.

### The shares each plan letter carries

| Policy | Foreign travel coinsurance | Skilled nursing facility coinsurance | Part B coinsurance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A | 0 per cent | 0 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan B | 0 per cent | 0 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D | 80 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K | 0 per cent | 50 per cent | 50 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N | 80 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G | 80 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G | 80 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent |

### Hypothetical selections

A waiting line on Plan N falling under foreign travel emergency care: the share taken is 80 per cent.

A waiting line on Plan K falling under skilled nursing facility care, with no foreign travel line waiting: the share taken is 50 per cent.

A waiting line on Plan K falling under neither benefit: the share taken is that letter's Part B coinsurance of 50 per cent.
